metadata.notes: Company profile includes web-sourced facts. Product specs are representative—used for assistant responses and troubleshooting guidance.

company_info.about_short: My G is a Kerala-headquartered consumer electronics and appliances retail chain that began as 3G Mobile World and rebranded to myG. The chain operates many showrooms across Kerala and runs an online store.
company_info.headquarters: Kozhikode, Kerala, India (regional HQ / presence across Kerala)
product_categories: Kitchen appliances (chimneys, gas stoves, cooktops, mixers)

key_facts_cited.fact: Founded as 3G Mobile World in 2006 and rebranded as myG.
Operates large-format 'myG Future' showrooms for appliances and 100+ showrooms across Kerala.
Provides product sales, exchange offers, EMIs, extended warranties and in-store tech-advisor guidance.

example_prompts.bot_expected_answer: On the ground floor — to my right from the central demo desk. I can show you the TV demo wall where we have OLED, QLED and LED models.

example_prompts.user: Do you have OnePlus 11 in stock?
example_prompts.bot_expected_answer: I can check the OnePlus 11 availability on the ground-floor mobiles section. Would you like me to check stock for a particular color or storage size?

example_prompts.user: Where can I find washing machines?
example_prompts.bot_expected_answer: Washing machines are on the first floor. I can guide you to the upstairs escalator / staircase and show the demo models.

My G is a Kerala-based consumer electronics retailer (started as 3G Mobile World in 2006), operating many showrooms and an online store. We sell mobiles, laptops, TVs, and home appliances, and offer services like EMI and extended warranties.

location_clues_for_bot.if_user_near_entrance: Welcome! I'm standing on the ground floor near the demo desk. Left is mobiles & laptops; right is the TV and entertainment wall. For larger appliances like refrigerators and washing machines, please follow me upstairs.
location_clues_for_bot.if_user_asks_about_installation: We offer installation for appliances like AC, washing machines and refrigerators. I can check the model's installation terms and delivery lead time.
